Class SDL_GPUViewport

java.lang.Object
org.lwjgl.system.Pointer.Default
org.lwjgl.system.Struct<SDL_GPUViewport>
org.lwjgl.sdl.SDL_GPUViewport
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, NativeResource, Pointer
public class SDL_GPUViewport extends Struct<SDL_GPUViewport> implements NativeResource
struct SDL_GPUViewport {
    float x;
    float y;
    float w;
    float h;
    float min_depth;
    float max_depth;
}

  • Constructor Details

    • SDL_GPUViewport

      public SDL_GPUViewport(ByteBuffer container)
      Creates a SDL_GPUViewport instance at the current position of the specified ByteBuffer container. Changes to the buffer's content will be visible to the struct instance and vice versa.

      The created instance holds a strong reference to the container object.
